name: 07677 · Woodcliff Lk, NJ
findings: ZIP 07677 (Woodcliff Lk) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07677 (Woodcliff Lk) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07677 (Woodcliff Lk) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
